name: asset_daily_coverage
definition:
SELECT asset_daily_ohlcv.symbol,
    count(*) AS rows,
    min(asset_daily_ohlcv."time") AS earliest,
    max(asset_daily_ohlcv."time") AS latest,
    max(asset_daily_ohlcv.source::text) AS last_source
   FROM asset_daily_ohlcv
  GROUP BY asset_daily_ohlcv.symbol
  ORDER BY asset_daily_ohlcv.symbol;

name: market_ohlcv_daily
definition:
SELECT da.asset_id,
    d."time" AS bar_start_utc,
    d."time" + '1 day'::interval AS bar_end_utc,
    (d."time" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota'::text) AS timestamp_cot,
    (d."time" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date AS session_date_local,
    da.session_tz AS market_timezone,
    d.open,
    d.high,
    d.low,
    d.close,
    d.volume,
    d.source,
        CASE
            WHEN d.source::text ~~ '%snapshot%'::text THEN 'snapshot'::text
            ELSE 'native'::text
        END AS bar_origin,
    d.available_at,
        CASE
            WHEN d.high >= GREATEST(d.open, d.close) AND d.low <= LEAST(d.open, d.close) AND d.high >= d.low THEN 'ok'::text
            ELSE 'incoherent_ohlc'::text
        END AS quality_status
   FROM asset_daily_ohlcv d
     JOIN dim_asset da ON da.symbol = d.symbol::text;

name: market_ohlcv_daily_wide
definition:
WITH grid AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT market_ohlcv_daily.session_date_local AS d
           FROM market_ohlcv_daily
        ), px AS (
         SELECT market_ohlcv_daily.asset_id,
            market_ohlcv_daily.bar_start_utc,
            market_ohlcv_daily.bar_end_utc,
            market_ohlcv_daily.timestamp_cot,
            market_ohlcv_daily.session_date_local,
            market_ohlcv_daily.market_timezone,
            market_ohlcv_daily.open,
            market_ohlcv_daily.high,
            market_ohlcv_daily.low,
            market_ohlcv_daily.close,
            market_ohlcv_daily.volume,
            market_ohlcv_daily.source,
            market_ohlcv_daily.bar_origin,
            market_ohlcv_daily.available_at,
            market_ohlcv_daily.quality_status
           FROM market_ohlcv_daily
        ), cal AS (
         SELECT market_session_calendar.asset_id,
            market_session_calendar.session_date,
            market_session_calendar.is_trading_day,
            market_session_calendar.session_open_utc,
            market_session_calendar.session_close_utc
           FROM market_session_calendar
        ), firsts AS (
         SELECT market_ohlcv_daily.asset_id,
            min(market_ohlcv_daily.session_date_local) AS first_bar
           FROM market_ohlcv_daily
          GROUP BY market_ohlcv_daily.asset_id
        ), macro AS (
         SELECT macro_indicators_daily.fecha,
            macro_indicators_daily.fxrt_index_dxy_usa_d_dxy AS dxy,
            macro_indicators_daily.volt_vix_usa_d_vix AS vix,
            macro_indicators_daily.crsk_spread_embi_col_d_embi AS embi,
            macro_indicators_daily.comm_oil_brent_glb_d_brent AS brent,
            macro_indicators_daily.comm_oil_wti_glb_d_wti AS wti,
            macro_indicators_daily.comm_metal_gold_glb_d_gold AS gold,
            macro_indicators_daily.comm_agri_coffee_glb_d_coffee AS coffee,
            macro_indicators_daily.eqty_index_colcap_col_d_colcap AS colcap,
            macro_indicators_daily.finc_bond_yield10y_usa_d_ust10y AS ust10y,
            macro_indicators_daily.finc_bond_yield2y_usa_d_dgs2 AS dgs2,
            macro_indicators_daily.finc_bond_yield5y_col_d_col5y AS col5y,
            macro_indicators_daily.finc_bond_yield10y_col_d_col10y AS col10y,
            macro_indicators_daily.finc_rate_ibr_overnight_col_d_ibr AS ibr,
            macro_indicators_daily.polr_policy_rate_col_d_tpm AS tpm,
            macro_indicators_daily.polr_prime_rate_usa_d_prime AS prime,
            macro_indicators_daily.fxrt_spot_usdcop_col_d_usdcop AS usdcop_spot,
            macro_indicators_daily.fxrt_spot_usdmxn_mex_d_usdmxn AS usdmxn,
            macro_indicators_daily.fxrt_spot_usdclp_chl_d_usdclp AS usdclp
           FROM macro_indicators_daily
        )
 SELECT (g.d::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text) AS bar_start_utc,
    ((g.d + 1)::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text) AS bar_end_utc,
    g.d::timestamp without time zone AS timestamp_cot,
    g.d AS session_date_cot,
    ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or(s.st = 'missing'::text) THEN 'missing'::text
                    WHEN bool_or(s.st = 'pending'::text) THEN 'pending'::text
                    WHEN bool_or(s.st = 'partial'::text) THEN 'partial'::text
                    ELSE 'ok'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM ( VALUES (
                        CASE
                            WHEN g.d < f1.first_bar THEN 'closed'::text
                            WHEN c1.is_trading_day IS NOT TRUE THEN 'closed'::text
                            WHEN p1.close IS NOT NULL THEN 'ok'::text
                            WHEN g.d >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date THEN 'pending'::text
                            ELSE 'missing'::text
                        END), (
                        CASE
                            WHEN g.d < f2.first_bar THEN 'closed'::text
                            WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM g.d) = 6::numeric THEN 'closed'::text
                            WHEN p2.close IS NOT NULL THEN 'ok'::text
                            WHEN g.d >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date THEN 'pending'::text
                            ELSE 'missing'::text
                        END), (
                        CASE
                            WHEN g.d < f3.first_bar THEN 'closed'::text
                            WHEN p3.close IS NOT NULL THEN 'ok'::text
                            WHEN g.d >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date THEN 'pending'::text
                            ELSE 'missing'::text
                        END), (
                        CASE
                            WHEN g.d < f4.first_bar THEN 'closed'::text
                            WHEN c4.is_trading_day IS NOT TRUE THEN 'closed'::text
                            WHEN p4.close IS NOT NULL THEN 'ok'::text
                            WHEN g.d >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date THEN 'pending'::text
                            ELSE 'missing'::text
                        END)) s(st)
          WHERE s.st <> 'closed'::text) AS availability_status,
    p1.open AS open_usdcop,
    p1.high AS high_usdcop,
    p1.low AS low_usdcop,
    p1.close AS close_usdcop,
    p1.volume AS volume_usdcop,
    p1.source AS source_usdcop,
    p1.bar_origin AS bar_origin_usdcop,
    COALESCE(c1.is_trading_day, false) AS is_session_bar_usdcop,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - p1.bar_end_utc)::bigint AS staleness_seconds_usdcop,
        CASE
            WHEN g.d < f1.first_bar THEN 'no_native_data'::text
            WHEN c1.is_trading_day IS NOT TRUE THEN
            CASE
                WHEN p1.close IS NULL THEN 'closed'::text
                ELSE 'off_session'::text
            END
            WHEN p1.close IS NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN g.d >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date THEN 'pending'::text
                ELSE 'missing'::text
            END
            WHEN p1.quality_status <> 'ok'::text THEN 'incoherent'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status_usdcop,
    p2.open AS open_xauusd,
    p2.high AS high_xauusd,
    p2.low AS low_xauusd,
    p2.close AS close_xauusd,
    p2.volume AS volume_xauusd,
    p2.source AS source_xauusd,
    p2.bar_origin AS bar_origin_xauusd,
    p2.close IS NOT NULL AS is_session_bar_xauusd,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - p2.bar_end_utc)::bigint AS staleness_seconds_xauusd,
        CASE
            WHEN g.d < f2.first_bar THEN 'no_native_data'::text
            WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM g.d) = 6::numeric THEN
            CASE
                WHEN p2.close IS NULL THEN 'closed'::text
                ELSE 'off_session'::text
            END
            WHEN p2.close IS NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN g.d >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date THEN 'pending'::text
                ELSE 'missing'::text
            END
            WHEN p2.quality_status <> 'ok'::text THEN 'incoherent'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status_xauusd,
    p3.open AS open_btcusdt,
    p3.high AS high_btcusdt,
    p3.low AS low_btcusdt,
    p3.close AS close_btcusdt,
    p3.volume AS volume_btcusdt,
    p3.source AS source_btcusdt,
    p3.bar_origin AS bar_origin_btcusdt,
    true AS is_session_bar_btcusdt,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - p3.bar_end_utc)::bigint AS staleness_seconds_btcusdt,
        CASE
            WHEN g.d < f3.first_bar THEN 'no_native_data'::text
            WHEN p3.close IS NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN g.d >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date THEN 'pending'::text
                ELSE 'missing'::text
            END
            WHEN p3.quality_status <> 'ok'::text THEN 'incoherent'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status_btcusdt,
    p4.open AS open_spx500,
    p4.high AS high_spx500,
    p4.low AS low_spx500,
    p4.close AS close_spx500,
    p4.volume AS volume_spx500,
    p4.source AS source_spx500,
    p4.bar_origin AS bar_origin_spx500,
    COALESCE(c4.is_trading_day, false) AS is_session_bar_spx500,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - p4.bar_end_utc)::bigint AS staleness_seconds_spx500,
        CASE
            WHEN g.d < f4.first_bar THEN 'no_native_data'::text
            WHEN c4.is_trading_day IS NOT TRUE THEN
            CASE
                WHEN p4.close IS NULL THEN 'closed'::text
                ELSE 'off_session'::text
            END
            WHEN p4.close IS NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN g.d >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date THEN 'pending'::text
                ELSE 'missing'::text
            END
            WHEN p4.quality_status <> 'ok'::text THEN 'incoherent'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS status_spx500,
    ma.dxy AS macro_dxy,
    lag(ma.dxy) OVER w AS macro_dxy_t1,
    ma.vix AS macro_vix,
    lag(ma.vix) OVER w AS macro_vix_t1,
    ma.embi AS macro_embi,
    lag(ma.embi) OVER w AS macro_embi_t1,
    ma.brent AS macro_brent,
    lag(ma.brent) OVER w AS macro_brent_t1,
    ma.wti AS macro_wti,
    lag(ma.wti) OVER w AS macro_wti_t1,
    ma.gold AS macro_gold,
    lag(ma.gold) OVER w AS macro_gold_t1,
    ma.coffee AS macro_coffee,
    lag(ma.coffee) OVER w AS macro_coffee_t1,
    ma.colcap AS macro_colcap,
    lag(ma.colcap) OVER w AS macro_colcap_t1,
    ma.ust10y AS macro_ust10y,
    lag(ma.ust10y) OVER w AS macro_ust10y_t1,
    ma.dgs2 AS macro_dgs2,
    lag(ma.dgs2) OVER w AS macro_dgs2_t1,
    ma.col5y AS macro_col5y,
    lag(ma.col5y) OVER w AS macro_col5y_t1,
    ma.col10y AS macro_col10y,
    lag(ma.col10y) OVER w AS macro_col10y_t1,
    ma.ibr AS macro_ibr,
    lag(ma.ibr) OVER w AS macro_ibr_t1,
    ma.tpm AS macro_tpm,
    lag(ma.tpm) OVER w AS macro_tpm_t1,
    ma.prime AS macro_prime,
    lag(ma.prime) OVER w AS macro_prime_t1,
    ma.usdcop_spot AS macro_usdcop_spot,
    lag(ma.usdcop_spot) OVER w AS macro_usdcop_spot_t1,
    ma.usdmxn AS macro_usdmxn,
    lag(ma.usdmxn) OVER w AS macro_usdmxn_t1,
    ma.usdclp AS macro_usdclp,
    lag(ma.usdclp) OVER w AS macro_usdclp_t1
   FROM grid g
     LEFT JOIN px p1 ON p1.asset_id = 'usdcop'::text AND p1.session_date_local = g.d
     LEFT JOIN px p2 ON p2.asset_id = 'xauusd'::text AND p2.session_date_local = g.d
     LEFT JOIN px p3 ON p3.asset_id = 'btcusdt'::text AND p3.session_date_local = g.d
     LEFT JOIN px p4 ON p4.asset_id = 'spx500'::text AND p4.session_date_local = g.d
     LEFT JOIN cal c1 ON c1.asset_id = 'usdcop'::text AND c1.session_date = g.d
     LEFT JOIN cal c4 ON c4.asset_id = 'spx500'::text AND c4.session_date = g.d
     LEFT JOIN firsts f1 ON f1.asset_id = 'usdcop'::text
     LEFT JOIN firsts f2 ON f2.asset_id = 'xauusd'::text
     LEFT JOIN firsts f3 ON f3.asset_id = 'btcusdt'::text
     LEFT JOIN firsts f4 ON f4.asset_id = 'spx500'::text
     LEFT JOIN macro ma ON ma.fecha = g.d
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY g.d);
